name: Open WebUI
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Open WebUI is a chat interface for Ollama and OpenAI-compatible APIs, with documents, web search and accounts, keeping its data in SQLite. Installs it with PyTorch for the CPU at first start; the first account made becomes the admin, and sign-ups are closed after it.
startup: export TMPDIR=/home/container/.raptor-build UV_LINK_MODE=copy UV_NO_CACHE=1; ver=$(cat .open-webui-version 2>/dev/null) || { echo "Open WebUI isn't installed: reinstall the server."; exit 1; }; py="$(python3 --version) $(uname -m)"; if [ "$ver $py" != "$(cat .venv/.raptor-installed 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "Installing Open WebUI $ver. The first time takes several minutes."; rm -rf $TMPDIR; mkdir -p $TMPDIR; { { [ "$py" = "$(cat .venv/.raptor-python 2>/dev/null)" ] || { python3 -m venv --clear .venv && echo "$py" > .venv/.raptor-python; }; } && .venv/bin/pip install -q --no-cache-dir --disable-pip-version-check uv && .venv/bin/uv pip install -q --python .venv/bin/python "torch<=2.9.1" --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu && .venv/bin/uv pip install -q --python .venv/bin/python "open-webui==$ver" && echo "$ver $py" > .venv/.raptor-installed; } || { rm -rf $TMPDIR; echo "Open WebUI $ver couldn't be installed."; exit 1; }; rm -rf $TMPDIR; fi; unset TMPDIR; b() { [ "$1" = 1 ] && echo True || echo False; }; export ENABLE_SIGNUP=$(b {{ENABLE_SIGNUP}}) ENABLE_VERSION_UPDATE_CHECK=$(b {{UPDATE_CHECK}}) ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY=$(b {{TELEMETRY}}) DATA_DIR=/home/container/data HF_HOME=/home/container/data/cache/huggingface SENTENCE_TRANSFORMERS_HOME=/home/container/data/cache/embedding WHISPER_MODEL_DIR=/home/container/data/cache/whisper TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR=/home/container/data/cache/tiktoken; [ "{{TELEMETRY}}" = 1 ] || export SCARF_NO_ANALYTICS=true DO_NOT_TRACK=true; for v in OLLAMA_BASE_URL OPENAI_API_BASE_URL OPENAI_API_KEY WEBUI_URL; do [ -n "${!v}" ] || unset $v; done; (trap "" INT TERM; for i in $(seq 600); do sleep 2; curl -fs -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:{{SERVER_PORT}}/health && exec echo "Open WebUI is ready on port {{SERVER_PORT}}."; done) & exec .venv/bin/open-webui serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port {{SERVER_PORT}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Open WebUI: checks the chosen version on PyPI. Open WebUI itself is
# installed when the server starts, into its own Python environment (.venv),
# for the Python version it runs. Your data (data/: the database, uploads and
# settings) is never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
want="${VERSION:-latest}"
want="${want#v}"
if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
    url=https://pypi.org/pypi/open-webui/json
else
    url="https://pypi.org/pypi/open-webui/$want/json"
fi
out=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$out"' EXIT
code=$(curl -sSL -A "raptor-installer (+https://raptorpanel.net)" -o "$out" -w '%{http_code}' "$url") || fail "PyPI can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
[ "$code" = 404 ] && fail "Open WebUI has no version $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 0.13.3."
[ "$code" = 200 ] || fail "PyPI can't be reached right now (HTTP $code). Reinstall to try again."
version=$(jq -r .info.version "$out")
echo "$version" > .open-webui-version
mkdir -p data
echo "Installed Open WebUI $version. It's set up when the server starts."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Open WebUI version to install, such as 0.13.3, or latest. Reinstall the server to change it.

variables.name: Ollama address
variables.description: The address of your Ollama server: http, its IP and port 11434 unless you changed it. Used when the database is first made; after that, change it in Admin settings.

variables.name: OpenAI-compatible address
variables.description: The address of an OpenAI-compatible API, ending in /v1 for most. Used when the database is first made; after that, change it in Admin settings.

variables.name: OpenAI-compatible API key
variables.description: The key for that API. Used when the database is first made; after that, change it in Admin settings.

variables.name: Public address
variables.description: The full address people open Open WebUI at, for links and sign-in providers.

variables.name: Open sign-ups
variables.description: Let anyone create an account after the first one, which becomes the admin. New accounts still wait for an admin's approval. Used when the database is first made; after that, change it in Admin settings.

variables.name: Update check
variables.description: Ask Open WebUI's servers whether a new version is out.

variables.name: Telemetry
variables.description: Send anonymous usage data to Open WebUI's and its libraries' developers.
